joint_slo.basis: Same predeclared exploratory thresholds as normal_capacity/session-r01; not a production SLO. No threshold selected from completion-handoff outcomes.

fixed.admission: native FCFS, cap256 in every arm
fixed.B_COMPLETION_FINALIZE: only policy variable: native or after_sample
fixed.workload_sha256_semantics: Canonical JSON hash checked by the original input loader; distinct from the serialized file hash below.
fixed.transfers: Native handlers, concurrency, streams, buffers, reference counts and STORE submission ordering unchanged. The entire original finalizer moves: prepare_store_kv and both LOAD/STORE completion observation move together; deferred STORE submission remains in the next native step.
fixed.warmup: original short32x16, short32x32, long2x2, output16; independent empty caches in every cell
fixed.observations: same recovery-order observer and completion-finalizer counters in every arm; no extra CUDA query or synchronization
fixed.arrival_sequence: same256 distinct natural article prefixes, alternating3072/512,0.1s source-order arrivals,EOS cap1024

selection: Fixed four arms; no conditional STORE-order opportunity filtering or latency-based reduction.
scope: Independent narrow native completion handoff candidate. Entire group including warmups holds the shared GPU flock. GPU UNRUN until recorded execution; local preparation is not scientific evidence.
